main_text.p: דָּבַק Haerere, Cohaerere, Conjunctum, Conglutinatum esse. Chald. Partic. דָּבְקִין Adhaerentes, Dan. 2. 43. Pyhal יְדֻבַּק Conglutinentur, Job 38.38. Hiphil הִדְבִּיק Adhaerere fecit, Conglutinavit. Hophal Partic. מְדֻבָּק Adhaerere facta.
דֶּבֶק m. Glutinum: juntura, Commissura: plur. דְּבָקִים.

דָּבַר Loqui, Eloqui. Niphal נִדְבַּר Assiduè loqui, Obloqui, Dictitare, Praedicare. Pihel דִּבֵּר Dixit, Edixit, Locutus, Allocutus est. Pyhal דֻּבַּר Sermo factus fuit, Praedicatum fuit. Hiphil הֵדִיב Duxit, ex Chaldaismo. Hithpahel, הִתְדַּבֵּר Sermocinari.
דָּבָר m. Sermo, Verbum. Res. עַל־דְּבַר Propter rem, Propter, Causâ, Ratione: plur. דְּבָרִים.
דִּבְרָה f. Ductus: unde עַל־דִּבְרַת Pro ratione: Secundum rationem, ordinem, ductum, & simpliciter, Propter. Sic Chaldaicè in Daniele.

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek vocalisation is approximate; the vowel points on the scan are small and partly doubtful. The running head reads דב. The page number is printed at top left as 65.
